<!-- Generated by tools/errors.py from data/errors.yml. Do not edit. -->

Each error has a stable ID, such as `ST-LIC-002`. Search this site for the ID or for words from the message, or read the ID to support over the phone.

Each page shows the message as you see it, where it appears, why it happens, how to fix it and how to check the fix. For the REST API's `errorCode` values see [API error codes](/docs/troubleshooting/error-codes/).
